credential_fields.label: Application (client) ID
credential_fields.tip: In the Azure Portal → App registrations → your app → Overview, copy the "Application (client) ID".

credential_fields.label: Client Secret Value
credential_fields.tip: In your Azure app → Certificates & secrets → New client secret. Copy the secret's Value (not its Secret ID) right away — the Value is hidden once you leave the page.

requires: Azure App Registration: Application (client) ID + a Client Secret
setup_hint: Register an app (supported account types: any Microsoft account), add the exact Redirect URI below as a "Web" platform redirect, then create a client secret and paste its Value.
